clauses.quote: nonprobationary employees having the least length of service will be the first laid off.
clauses.subject_text: nonprobationary employees having the least length of service

clauses.quote: Any employee terminated pursuant to this policy in order to have recall rights, shall reapply to the system
clauses.subject_text: Any employee terminated pursuant to this policy in order to have recall rights

clauses.quote: such employee will be given priority consideration when the position from which he or she was terminated is posted by the Board for one (1) calendar year from the effective date of his or her termination.
Upon call back, the employee will be given five working days to accept employment.
Pis or her rights of recall are forfeited.
clauses.subject_text: Pis or her rights of recall
clauses.notes: OCR typo 'Pis' for 'his or her'; clause describes loss of a retained right.

clauses.quote: Furthermore, non-probationary employees will be given priority consideration in other vacant positions in the system whereby they possess the necessary skills to do the job.
